title: benchmark lab: improve reporting pipeline + add representative workload runners
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Adds new reporting pipeline for benchmark results, new workload runners (llm-chat, embedding-bulk, rerank), CI aggregation for benchmark metrics, and profiling baseline artifacts. No user-facing breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: the existing benchmark lab reporting pipeline was fragmented and did not capture consistent timeseries metrics across workload runners. This PR centralizes metric aggregation, adds representative workload runners for chat, embeddings, and reranking, and produces profiling baselines for our CI regression checks.

What changed: consolidated reporting pipeline (benchmark-lab/pipelines/reporting_v2.py), three workload runners (llm_chat_runner, embedding_runner, rerank_runner), standard profiles configs (benchmark-lab/configs/profiles.yaml), CI workflow to run representative workloads nightly and push aggregated metrics to timeseries DB (ci/workflows/benchmarks.yml). The description below is a checklist of the notable items implemented: 
- New reporting_v2 pipeline that normalizes result format, calculates p50/p90/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-token.
- Workload runners: llm_chat_runner (multi-turn chat patterns with KV-cache stress), embedding_runner (bulk embedding throughput and memory sampling), rerank_runner (batch scoring and end-to-end latency).
- Profiling baselines: capture CPU/GPU utilization traces and kernel-level profiles; artifacts uploaded to s3-like storage for offline analysis.
- CI: nightly benchmarks job that runs representative workloads, aggregates metrics, and fails if latency regressions vs baseline exceed configured thresholds.
- Docs: updated docs/benchmarks.md with runbook and interpretation guide.

Testing notes: added unit tests for parser/aggregator and synthetic load tests in benchmarks/test_runners.py. Nightly job validated on staging cluster for two weeks before merge.

Checklist:
- [x] Reporting pipeline implementation
- [x] Workload runners implemented and smoke-tested
- [x] Profiling baselines produced and uploaded
- [x] CI workflow added and validated on staging
- [x] Docs updated

Context and links: Linked Linear tasks ENG-3421 (reporting pipeline redesign) and ENG-3487 (representative workload runners). Related PRs: pr-2142 (initial benchmark runners reporting pipeline) and pr-5821 (workload runners and reporting pipeline).
